propositions: explain_guide() and explain_criterion() fail with missing-file when rebar is installed as a library/CLI/MCP and run against a project lacking docs/, because they resolve guide markdown via repo_root(...)/docs/ (the consuming project's git root, not the rebar package)

Author guides must be packaged as in-package resources under src/rebar/_guides/ and resolved via importlib.resources matching the OSS convention (same pattern rebar uses for criteria_routing.json) to make them accessible from any installation
AUTHOR_GUIDES should change from path-component tuples to bare filenames; explain_guide(name) should resolve via resources.files('rebar._guides') and drop the repo_root_path parameter

explain_criterion(id) should render sections directly from the packaged registry via _guide_section_body() instead of reading docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md; overlay project criteria still resolve via load_criteria(repo_root=...)
docs/ copies must remain as thin pointer files so existing links in docs/README.md and AGENTS.md do not break

Dev/CI machinery (regenerate_criteria_guide, validate_criteria_guide, coach guide_url deep-link) must remain unchanged; CLI/MCP/library surfaces must succeed without docs/ present in the target project
